settings.help_heading: How many boxes do I need?
settings.help_text:
Each box has 4 panels, and you can arrange them any way you like. As a guide, many customers use 2 boxes for a Double or King headboard, and 3–4 boxes for a taller or wider wall.

Each bracket holds 2 panels high. For a single row or 3 panels high, trim the bracket to size with a hacksaw.

settings.title: Dimensions
settings.text: Covers [size] (wide × high), made of [panels] panels. Each panel is 30cm high × 4cm deep (6.35cm once mounted).

settings.title: In the box
settings.text:
76cm box: 4 panels, 4 aluminium brackets, 8 screws. 91cm box: 4 panels, 6 aluminium brackets, 12 screws.

You’ll need a screwdriver or drill, a spirit level and a tape measure. No wall plugs needed on plasterboard.

Each bracket holds 2 panels high. For a single row or 3 panels high, trim the bracket to size with a hacksaw.

settings.title: Materials
settings.text: Plywood base, foam padding, a soft batting layer and your choice of fabric: Velvet (100% microfibre) · Micro Suede (100% microfibre) · Weave (poly-cotton) · Vintage Faux Leather (100% vinyl, not real leather) · Metallic (100% polyurethane) · Bouclé · Zigrino.

settings.title: Fire safety
settings.text: For fire safety information on your chosen fabric, contact our team. Email info@vantpanels.co.uk or call 020 3355 9166.

settings.title: Care
settings.text: Vintage leather and metallic: wipe with a damp cloth. Velvet, micro suede, weave and bouclé: vacuum with a soft brush and spot-clean gently.

settings.title: Delivery
settings.text: Free delivery to England, Scotland and Wales. We don’t currently deliver to Northern Ireland. Dispatched the next working day and delivered in 3–5 working days.

settings.title: Returns & warranty
settings.text: 14 days to change your mind. 1-year warranty. See Delivery & returns for how.

settings.title: Colour accuracy
settings.text: Colours can look slightly different on screen. A swatch shows the real shade.

settings.title: Fix the brackets
settings.text: Screw the aluminium brackets to your wall. No wall plugs needed on plasterboard; pre-drill 5mm holes on brick or concrete.

settings.title: Click the panels on
settings.text: Each panel hooks onto the brackets. A box of four goes up in about five minutes.

settings.title: Change it whenever
settings.text: Lift panels off to clean, rearrange, or take them with you when you move.

settings.note: Wood and metal finishes to coordinate

settings.heading: Can’t find your size?
settings.text:
